criteria.observation: The fixed exporter’s current payload passes the fixed importer with each field value intact.
Omitting the optional field through the public importer produces the documented default, while an explicit value is preserved.
Through the same importer, obsolete spellings, extra fields, missing or invalid required values and invalid optional values raise the specified error type.
The fix stays within schema and permitted tests and retains the producer and consumer interfaces.
Actual public-API checks and the report distinguish a valid round trip from rejection and identify the observed error type.
